longTitle: How Many Retirees Actually Have $1 Million? (New Fed Data)
sources: Sources: Federal Reserve Board, 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances, summary extract public data (our calculation with survey weights; all figures in 2025 dollars); Bengen (1994), 4% rule of thumb.

clips.title: How many retirees really have $1 million? It depends #Shorts
clips.desc: Households 65+ (Federal Reserve, 2025 SCF): everything ~32%, without the house ~23%, savings ~18%, 401(k)/IRA ~11%.
